name: guile
description: Stand up and drive a Guile socket REPL from an agent: guile3 --debug --listen on a per-project port, a transcript-logging proxy on PORT+1, the eval bridge that makes "verified" mean something, and an Emacs/Geiser setup that derives the same ports and load path. Use when starting or resuming a Guile/Scheme project, when a claim about Guile behaviour needs checking against a running interpreter, when a REPL session should be recorded, or when Emacs and Geiser should attach to the same REPL.
